note: Allein fällt das Familienleben des Silberrückens weg, übrig bleibt die Giraffe, ein Riese, der über offenes Land zieht. Der Gorilla steht nur noch für die tiefe Einsamkeit und die Suche nach einer Familie.

analogs.covers: Body and life alone: a towering browser roaming open country, avoiding dense forest and deep water
Heart: a deeply social gentle giant that grieves, grows lonely and searches for a family

solo.headline: A lone giraffe giant that cannot bear being alone: it seeks the company of any sauropod and even follows carnivores, calling sadly when they chase it off.
solo.playsLike: Alone, an Argentinosaurus feels a deep sense of loneliness. You seek out any company you can find: your own kind, other sauropods, or other dinosaurs altogether. You may follow carnivores below Apex tier just for interaction, and when they aggress you away you call out sadly. As a bull alone you wear dull, desaturated colours. You group with other sauropods and are more sociable than in a tower or village. You still fear almost nothing but pairs of Apex carnivores, never panic-flee and stand your ground.

why.text: “Solitary Argentinosaurus exhibit a deep sense of loneliness.” A silverback that has lost its group wanders in search of a new family.
Adults “will seek out any company they can find, whether that be their own kind, other sauropods, or other dinosaurs all together”.
It may even follow carnivores below Apex tier for interaction, and is chased off with sad calls in return.
Bulls “possess dull, desaturated colorations when alone” and only flush bright when they court or lead a harem.
A towering browser that avoids dense forest and water too deep to stand in, and stands its ground instead of fleeing.

notLike: Lone giraffe bulls are content on their own; a solitary Argentinosaurus grows depressed if alone for too long.
Giraffes are fast runners; Argentinosaurus is the slowest land-walker on the roster.
solo.summary: Allein bist du eine riesige Giraffe, die das Alleinsein kaum erträgt. Du suchst jede Gesellschaft, die du finden kannst: Artgenossen, andere Sauropoden oder ganz andere Dinosaurier. Du folgst sogar Fleischfressern unter Apex, nur um nicht allein zu sein, und rufst traurig, wenn sie dich verjagen. Als Bulle trägst du allein matte, blasse Farben. Fürchten musst du fast nichts außer Apex-Paaren, und du fliehst nie, du bleibst stehen. Dein Ziel bleibt eine Village mit Geschwistern oder ein Tower.
